scripts.build: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && npx wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir pkg && cp index.html pkg/
scripts.dev: npx wasm-pack build --target web --dev --out-dir pkg && cp index.html pkg/ && node server.js
scripts.dev:watch: cargo watch -x 'npx wasm-pack build --target web --dev --out-dir pkg' -s 'cp index.html pkg/'
